correctness.rationale: RESULT.md (blob aa5c13930c6ce853097aa6660137ddf613b92537) correctly identifies all 2n closed-neighborhood tetrahedra for a circular ladder n>=5, with original f=(2n,7n,8n,2n). The open-neighbor triangles are free in unique tetrahedra, yielding 2n collapses. Skipping ring edges then each belong to a unique remaining ring triangle, yielding 2n more. The remainder is the union of the n tetrahedral boundaries on successive square vertex sets, with consecutive intersections exactly common rung edges; this space is S1 wedge n S2. H1(G) has rank n+1 and square cycles together with the rim form an integral basis, so the kernel rank and generators follow. No n<5 conclusion is asserted. The all-n proof is combinatorial; inspected finite script checks are supplementary.
